fields.invitation:
Join us for a night you will never forget at Neuschwanstein Castle. Black-tie dress code, fireworks at midnight, and a string quartet in the great hall.

Please RSVP a week in advance so we can confirm your name with castle security.

Boat club season is back! Come down to the Belgrade boat club for an afternoon on the Danube.

Bring something to share for the grill, a swimsuit, and a friend. We push off at noon and the music does not stop until sunset.

You are cordially invited to our wedding.

The ceremony will take place at noon, followed by a reception with dinner, dancing, and far too much cake. Please RSVP by the end of the month and let us know about any dietary preferences.

An evening at Schloss Belle awaits. Candlelit dinner in the orangery, a small jazz trio, and a tour of the gardens for those who arrive early.

Dress smart casual. Carriages at midnight.

Sea, sun, and salt on the lips. Meet us in Piran for a long lazy weekend of seafood, swimming, and watching the boats come in.

We have rooms blocked at a small hotel in the old town. Let me know if you would like one held for you.

Come to Schloss Liebe for a quiet weekend with old friends. Long walks in the woods, a fireplace that is always lit, and a kitchen that never quite closes.

No dress code, no agenda. Just bring yourself.

Garden party!

We are throwing open the gates for an afternoon in the garden. There will be tea, cocktails for the brave, and a long table set under the apple trees. Hats encouraged. Heels not advised.

Sunset drinks at Ljubljana Castle. The funicular runs until late and we have the terrace booked for the whole evening.

Come hungry and stay for the view over the old town.

We are hiking up and staying the night.

Meet at the trailhead at 9am sharp. Pack warm layers, good boots, and a bottle of something for the toast at the summit. Dinner is at the mountain hut once we arrive.

Yacht club season opener. Champagne on the deck, dinner in the dining room, and dancing until they kick us out.

Whites and navy please. RSVP by Friday so we can finalise the seating plan.

We are going to Bali and you are coming with us.

A villa in Ubud is booked for the whole week. Mornings in the rice fields, afternoons by the pool, evenings wherever the night takes us. Flights are on you, everything else is on us.

A weekend at the cottage by the sea. Bring a book, your worst jokes, and an appetite for too much food.

The fire pit gets going around sunset. Swimming for the brave starts before breakfast.

Lunch at Sunny Top followed by an afternoon of nothing in particular.

The view is the main attraction. Bring sunglasses and your best stories from the year.

A small get-together by the river. Drinks at the new place on the embankment, then dinner wherever we end up.

No plans beyond that. Come as you are.

Late summer night at the Poseidon club. Sea on one side, dance floor on the other.

Dress code is whatever you can dance in for six hours straight.

Backyard reunion. Long overdue.

Burgers on the grill, a cooler full of cold drinks, and probably someone's guitar by midnight. Bring the kids, bring the dogs, bring a chair if you have a favourite.

Tacos and tequila at the Baja Bar. We have the back room from eight o'clock.

Margaritas on me for the first round. After that you are on your own.

It is my birthday and I am taking us all to Noma. Tasting menu, wine pairing, the whole thing.

Please be on time. They do not hold tables, not even for me.

Mist club, new room, late opening. Doors at eleven, music until the lights come on.

Guestlist closes at ten so let me know in advance if you are coming.

Beach Bar takeover. We have the whole place from sunset onward.

Flip flops mandatory. Shoes are not allowed past the boardwalk.

Aperitivo at the Loggia followed by dinner upstairs.

A small group, a long table, and an evening with no rush. Bring an appetite and someone you have not seen in too long.

A weekend at Hotel Hill. Spa, long lunches, and absolutely no work emails.

Rooms are booked under the party name. Check-in opens at three.

Late summer at Zanetos. Whitewashed walls, blue doors, and a view that does not quit.

We are there for four days. Come for any of them or all of them.

Full moon on Koh Pha Ngan. We are flying out the week before to settle in.

Beach bungalows are sorted. Bring sunscreen, energy, and a sense of humour about sand getting into everything.

Anemos for the long weekend. Sailing in the morning, beach in the afternoon, dinner in town.

The boat is booked under my name. Bring a towel and a hat.
